name: 书剑恩仇录
english_description: A Chongqing Telecom "Book and Sword" MUD based on Jin Yong's novel of the same name (published in English as The Book and the Sword), part of the Century/adm-single engine family (adm/single/master.lpc plus adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) shared with sje, sjplgfjxb, and sjplii elsewhere in this archive.
